explication: PanSou is a Go API for searching cloud-drive resources through Telegram channels and extensible plugins, and checking whether shared links remain valid. The main workflow accepts a search request, runs selected sources concurrently, then returns classified and ranked results; link checks follow a separate API path. Authentication is optional. The README documents asynchronous plugin work and two-level caching. Source excerpts show the search, plugin, and cache wiring; unsampled integrations are represented only where documented, and individual plugin call paths are not inferred.
